summary: Top-level index with TOC, quick start, architecture overview and reading order for AI and devs.
Comprehensive technology inventory, version snapshot (Dec 2025) and development scripts/workflow.
Zod schema patterns and BaseEntity conventions for domain entities.
DTO generation patterns and helpers to decouple domain from transport shapes.
Mapper patterns (Entity ↔ DTO) and the `TBaseMapper` interface.
Guidelines to design minimal ports (interfaces) that return domain entities.
Use-case structure, orchestration rules and error handling patterns.
Zod validation and schema patterns for use-case inputs/outputs.
Behavior-driven specifications for use-cases and expected outcomes.
Domain error types, `BaseError` extension and `IErrorDetails` contract.
Hook patterns that wrap use-cases, adapter injection and caching rules.
Enum conventions and helper mappers (e.g., status, sex, autonomy level).
Drizzle schema conventions, snake_case vs camelCase mapping, and migration notes.
Adapter class template (Postgres/SQLite) and `toDomainEntity` mapping rules.
Testing patterns for adapters: mapping tests and DB query validation.
Ports & Adapters (Hexagonal) guide, `useAdapters` factory and examples (SQLite, Toast).
heroui-native mobile guidelines: wrapper atoms, `useThemeColor`, compound components and a11y.
Legacy web-focused heroui core docs (kept for reference).
How hooks should orchestrate port adapters inside UI context.
Page-level composition patterns and SafeArea/ScrollView best practices.
Integration & unit test patterns, Expo module mocks and Jest setup notes.
Toast system: BaseToast, AuraSVG (radial gradient), `ToastUINotifyPortAdapter` and design tokens.
Atomic Design guide for the app: atoms, molecules, organisms, particles + examples and naming rules.
i18next configuration, `Ti18nKeys` type-safety, `TextTranslation` component and workflow for adding keys.
